from pathlib import Path
import concurrent.futures,datetime as dt,json,urllib.request,urllib.error
root=Path('docs/workstreams/research/AF-RES-033/evidence');root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
targets=[(2843,'2020-01-04-13'),(2845,'2020-01-06-17'),(2850,'2020-01-13-13'),(2859,'2020-01-23-17')]
def check(target):
    number,hour=target;url=f'https://data.gharchive.org/{hour}.json.gz'
    row={'stage':'archive_head','repository':'rust-lang/rfcs','pr_number':number,'url':url,'method':'HEAD','started_utc':dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'equivalent_command':['curl','--head','--max-time','25',url]}
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url,method='HEAD',headers={'User-Agent':'AF-RES-033-provenance-audit'}),timeout=25) as response:
            row.update(status=response.status,final_url=response.url,content_length=response.headers.get('Content-Length'),content_type=response.headers.get('Content-Type'),etag=response.headers.get('ETag'),last_modified=response.headers.get('Last-Modified'))
    except Exception as exc:row.update(error_type=type(exc).__name__,error=str(exc))
    row['ended_utc']=dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat();return row
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:rows=list(pool.map(check,targets))
with (root/'opening-archive-attempts.jsonl').open('a') as f:
    for row in rows:f.write(json.dumps(row,sort_keys=True)+'\n');print(json.dumps(row,sort_keys=True))
